limitations: Requires fixed real parameters 0<a<b<3a and 0<c<cstar with cstar as in RESULT.md; no claim of all-parameter uniformity in a and b.
Only original-time period and occupation on the canonical algebraic oval are considered; no new existence, uniqueness, hyperbolicity, or c>cstar classification is asserted.
The oldest 1966 and 2004 papers were not accessible in full; equivalent earlier formulas remain possible.
Numerical quadrature verifies sample values but does not prove asymptotic limits or weak convergence.
